ics_213_ground_truth.4_subject: Downstream Municipal Water Intake Precautionary Shutoff Notice
ics_213_ground_truth.7_message: Field water monitoring team at Boom Site 2 reports low-level dissolved ammonia readings reaching 0.05 ppm near Blackwood River mile 14. Recommend immediately notifying Blackwood Water Authority to initiate precautionary intake gate closure.
ics_213_ground_truth.9_reply: Liaison Officer contacted Blackwood Water Authority at 19:50 hours. Water intake gates closed at 20:00 hours. Alternate reservoir supply activated.
